verdict.rationale: Brex's own materials say finance teams can set budgets and allocate spend limits with auto-enforced controls (brex-docs-6). A first-party Budgets API manages budgets and budget programs (brex-docs-2), and per-transaction limits are documented on team and vendor cards (brex-docs-15). Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how enforcement works (e.g. declines at the limit, or a soft vs. hard limit), explicit evidence that budgets are scoped to departments rather than only listing departments in the Team API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
